newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle marekt quiet, no trade - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle marekt quiet, no trade - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, USDA said. Buyer inquiry only fair. Some opening bids $103.00-$104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis. Selling side pricing stock higher, anywhere up to $107.00. Last quotable market $104.00 on Friday.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Confirmed: None. Last week: 200 Last year: 200
Wk to date: 3,700 Sm Pd Ls Wk: 1,700 Sm Pd Ls Yr: 600
